selectedFunctions.label: Multipli Deposit USDC for xUSDC
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution policies remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum xUSDC ERC1967/UUPS proxy 0x133229E0AdFf22c6F1AD287D199ea09d35E4427B is bound by official deployments and explorer to implementation 0x9921f41DF5A816Ff1940DbA35b8c394E4917667d. Owner/authority can upgrade, change external fee configuration, pause and manage reported strategy balances; no administration, executor, flash callback or bridge capabilities admitted.

Underlying is Ethereum USDC at 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 (6-decimal base units), not BSC USDC. xUSDC share units inherit underlying decimals with zero offset. Deposits/mints consume caller USDC allowance, require the mutable minimum deposit amount, and use operator-reported aggregate strategy balances plus vault cash for valuation. No fixed exchange rate, backing or yield is attested.

Both ordinary deposit/mint overloads are supported; third-argument deposit enforces minShares and third-argument mint enforces maxAssets. Two-argument forms lack a caller-set price bound, and none has a deadline. Mutable per-asset fee contract determines deposit and withdrawal fees; zero-fee FAQ copy is not a current configuration guarantee. Floor rounding can mint zero shares for small positive deposits; no current fee rate, minimum, cash balance or unpaused state has been inferred.

requestRedeem requires owner == msg.sender and positive owned xUSDC shares, transfers shares into the vault without share allowance and aggregates pending gross assets/shares by receiver. Request ID is always zero; receiver is an economically binding payout address and is not checked for zero here. No user cancellation, caller-set minimum net payout or on-chain fulfillment deadline exists.

Redemption is asynchronous operator fulfillment, not a user claim call: fulfillRedeem burns escrowed shares and pays receiver USDC minus then-applicable fees. Partial fulfillment is possible and relies on authorized operators and vault liquidity; official current Earn UI describes 7–14 day payout, not a contract-enforced guarantee. Direct withdraw/redeem always revert UseRequestRedeem and are excluded; requestInstantRedeem and cancelRedeem are authorized-only, not ordinary user alternatives.

Current live Earn UI explicitly offers Ethereum USDC → xUSDC deposit and sell-back. Older v2 FAQ says Avalanche-only; current deployment mapping and live interface supersede that network list. Legal terms restrict jurisdictions including US/Canada/sanctioned territories and may require compliance/KYC; permissionless user functions do not waive legal eligibility.

Underlying is Ethereum USDC at 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 (6-decimal base units), not BSC USDC. xUSDC share units inherit underlying decimals with zero offset. Deposits/mints consume caller USDC allowance, require the mutable minimum deposit amount, and use operator-reported aggregate strategy balances plus vault cash for valuation. No fixed exchange rate, backing or yield is attested.

Both ordinary deposit/mint overloads are supported; third-argument deposit enforces minShares and third-argument mint enforces maxAssets. Two-argument forms lack a caller-set price bound, and none has a deadline. Mutable per-asset fee contract determines deposit and withdrawal fees; zero-fee FAQ copy is not a current configuration guarantee. Floor rounding can mint zero shares for small positive deposits; no current fee rate, minimum, cash balance or unpaused state has been inferred.

requestRedeem requires owner == msg.sender and positive owned xUSDC shares, transfers shares into the vault without share allowance and aggregates pending gross assets/shares by receiver. Request ID is always zero; receiver is an economically binding payout address and is not checked for zero here. No user cancellation, caller-set minimum net payout or on-chain fulfillment deadline exists.

Redemption is asynchronous operator fulfillment, not a user claim call: fulfillRedeem burns escrowed shares and pays receiver USDC minus then-applicable fees. Partial fulfillment is possible and relies on authorized operators and vault liquidity; official current Earn UI describes 7–14 day payout, not a contract-enforced guarantee. Direct withdraw/redeem always revert UseRequestRedeem and are excluded; requestInstantRedeem and cancelRedeem are authorized-only, not ordinary user alternatives.

Current live Earn UI explicitly offers Ethereum USDC → xUSDC deposit and sell-back. Older v2 FAQ says Avalanche-only; current deployment mapping and live interface supersede that network list. Legal terms restrict jurisdictions including US/Canada/sanctioned territories and may require compliance/KYC; permissionless user functions do not waive legal eligibility.

underlyingAndUnits.shareDecimals: Inherited cached asset decimals + _decimalsOffset() == 0; canonical USDC uses 6. Proxy constructor initialization binds canonical Ethereum USDC.

sourceSemantics.depositMint: Both unprivileged overloads of deposit/mint share whenNotPaused logic and external-fee calculations, enforce mutable minimum assets, SafeERC20-transfer caller underlying then mint shares. deposit minShares/mint maxAssets wrappers revert atomically after core call if violated. No permits or caller-provided bytes involved.
sourceSemantics.valuationAndFees: totalAssets() is on-chain USDC cash plus authorized oracle-reported aggregatedUnderlyingBalances. It does not subtract totalPendingAssets. External IVariableVaultFee computes per-asset feeOnTotal/feeOnRaw; zero configuration reverts ConfiguredIncorrectly. Fee recipient and contract are mutable. previewDeposit subtracts total deposit fee; previewMint adds raw fee; ordinary token-transfer mechanics plus virtual shares/assets and directional rounding apply.
sourceSemantics.requestAndFulfillment: requestRedeem(owner=caller) requires shares>0 and sufficient caller balance, computes gross assets with super.previewRedeem before fee, transfers shares to vault and adds to pendingRedeem[receiver]. Return ID is always 0, not a unique claim token. Multiple owner requests can accumulate under any receiver, including different owners. Authorized fulfillment chooses shares/assets within pending balances, burns escrowed vault shares and sends net USDC/fee; no user claim function and no user cancel. Future fees/liquidity/operator action govern eventual payout.
sourceSemantics.pauseAndAuthority: _update is whenNotPaused, so share mint/burn/transfer and fulfillment can be blocked even where outer fulfillment lacks pause modifier. Owner/authority controls upgrades, oracle balances, adminMint/adminBurn, external fee contract, minimum, pause, and management paths. Deployed manage checks mutable authority but still accepts arbitrary target/calldata/value; flashRedeem accepts caller-selected operator callback bytes. Both excluded, not made safe by their authorization checks.
sourceSemantics.disabledInterface: withdraw and redeem explicitly revert UseRequestRedeem. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem inherited getters or preview helpers do not make those disabled transaction methods executable. requestInstantRedeem, fulfillInstantRedeem, cancelRedeem and standard fulfillRedeem all requireAuth and remain excluded.
sourceSemantics.eligibility: No requiresAuth modifier on selected ordinary deposit/mint/requestRedeem. This does not waive protocol terms/jurisdictional restrictions, requested compliance/KYC, or USDC transfer restrictions. No accredited-investor credit vault/RWA product, bridge or manager capability added.

limitations: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution policies remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.
